text.p: These are the leading stories in Botswana's independent midweek newspapers on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Botswana citizen Adam Mabina has denied he led six African National Congress members to their deaths. Mabina has been accused by an applicant to South Africa's "truth commission" of being a spy for the former white government in Pretoria.

- Women's organisations in Botswana are to petition Police Commissioner Norman Moleboge to review methods of handling cases of domestic violence. The women's groups accuse police of merely giving verbal warnings to abusers and refusing to take matters further.
- Opponents of the government's proposed Mass Media Bill have criticised its decision to go ahead with those parts of the planned legislation that apply to broadcasting.
- The Organisation of African Unity Human Rights Commission in Gambia is hearing the case of a man born in South Africa who claims he has been unfairly denied Botswana citizenship.
